marie: Quick sync — upstream FlashAttention repo merged a detection change that is causing our kernel-selector to pick a different kernel on some H100 builds. Saw odd latency on canary. TL;DR: need to pin or adapt selector.

 tj: FYI ran canary with FA v2.1.3 -> observed ~6% p50/p99 regression for seq=4096 on A100. Short trace attached.

 sahil: KV cache behavior note: when the selector falls back to paged-attn, we get extra KV copy ops which increase CPU overhead. I captured a timeline flame (see below).

 ci-bot: [perf-alert] canary 2026-03-15-21:12:42: p99 latency +6.2% vs baseline for model=gpt2-large seq=4096. Job: perf/canary-824

 quen: Microbench results: fused-attn vs vectorized FA variant.
```
config: bs=1 seq=2048 dtype=fp16
H100: fused 82ms vs flash 96ms
T4: fused 120ms vs flash 138ms
```
 Fused wins on older hardware; flash grows with sequence length faster.

 lukas: VendorX note — they removed their xFormers fork that had our custom vec4 patch. They suggest pinning to commit `a1b2c3d` until they publish new branch. Also vLLM reverted the attention-reorder PR that broke kv-shard tests.

 marie: Proposed action items:
 - pin FA at commit a1b2c3d in our build to stabilize canary (owner: marie)
 - add kernel-selection unit to perf matrix covering seq 512/1024/2048/4096 + H100/A100/T4 (owner: tj)
 - add KV-trace to telstate for paged-attn fallbacks (owner: sahil)
 - add automated alert that flags >3% p99 regressed kernel selection (owner: eng-sre)

 tj: I'll start on the perf matrix. Quick run command for repeatability:
```
python perf/run.py --model=gpt2 --seq=4096 --kernels=auto --runs=5
```

 sahil: I'll attach KV flamegraphs by EOD.

 marie: Thanks — let's reconvene after the first wave of pins and matrix runs. @ci-bot can you mark the canary as flaky and mute the p99 alert while we roll forward? :thumbsup:

 ci-bot: done — muted alert for perf/canary-824 for 6h (reason: upstream FA change)

 quen: One more datapoint: batching heuristics change in our scheduler (dynamic batch coalescing) amplifies the regression at low qps. Might need to tune thresholds.

 marie: Good catch. Add small experiment: static batch cap=32 vs dyn throttle. We'll log results in the perf board.

 lukas: Filing vendor ticket and pinged VendorX eng on Slack. Will post link when I have it.

 marie: Great. If anyone finds a fast workaround (compile flags, env vars) drop it here. Otherwise we'll proceed with pin + tests.
